file: a013/doc.pdf (Bio Fil Inc, 1-A/A EX1A-4 SUBS AGMT)
coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell: the cell's own rules. Tick box: the printed square (ink at 400 dpi). Picture pages: measured on the picture's own pixels and converted through the page's drawing matrix.
how_measured: pdfplumber characters and drawn rectangles (geom.json in work-g1); tick squares from ink at 400 dpi; every page looked at at 100 dpi; overlays drawn and looked at.

signing.kind: The purchaser signs page 8 as an individual (with a joint title owner if any) or as an entity, gives tax numbers, domicile and amount; Appendix A repeats shares and price; a blank IRS Form W-9 (a picture) is attached for the investor; the company accepts on page 8 with the number of shares and its signature.

sure_per_page.8: sure (judgements: the execution date over two lines is two places; the third tax number line is the joint subscribers')
sure_per_page.10: sure of the places; boxes measured on a 612 x 792 px picture (about 0.8 pt a pixel, so within 1 pixel = 0.8 pt); SSN and EIN taken as digit groups (3 + 2), not single cells
